title: getKey() falls back to finding_info.title (or f.message) when finding_info.uid is absent, then builds a Map keyed by that value - if two different resources in the same scan share an identical generic title with no uid, one silently overwrites the other in the Map, dropping it from the comparison entirely.
description: Conditional on finding_info.uid being missing (not the normal path) - if it happens, N-1 findings sharing a title vanish from a scan comparison instead of appearing as their own resolved/new/unchanged/changed row.
affectedFiles: vibrantix-backend/src/modules/cloud-posture/scan-comparison.js:40-51 (findingIdentity — composite key: provider+account+region+checkId+resource uid/id/name, only true last-resort is uid alone), :80-88 (groupByIdentity uses arrays per key, never a single-value overwrite), :137-143 (takeBaselineMatch consumes one array entry per current-finding match, sequential pairing instead of collapsing)
fixEvidence: The old Map<title, finding> single-value overwrite logic no longer exists. scan-comparison.js's findingIdentity() now builds a composite key from provider+account+region+checkId+resource-uid/id/name (falling back to title only as the very last component, not the whole key) — collisions on title alone are now far less likely. More importantly, groupByIdentity() (lines 80-88) stores an ARRAY of findings per identity key (not a single value), and compareRawScanFindings' takeBaselineMatch() (lines 137-143) consumes one array entry per matching current-scan finding via an index counter — so even if two findings do share an identity, both are paired sequentially (one becomes a genuine 'changed'/'unchanged' row, the other pairs with the next available baseline match or is reported as 'new'/'resolved') instead of one silently overwriting and dropping the other.
